title: Punjab Social Services Board Amendment Act 2013

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Social Services Board Amendment Act 2013
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIV OF 2013
ACT XIV OF 2013
PUNJAB SOCIAL SERVICES BOARD
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2013
An Act further to amend the Punjab Social
Services Board Ordinance, 1970
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary,
14th January, 2013]
No.PAP-Legis-2(142)12012/821,
dated 14-1-2013.---The Punjab Social Services Board (Amendment) Bill 2012,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 7 January 2013,
and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 12 January 2013, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further to amend the Punjab
Social Services Board Ordinance 1970 (II of 1970) for purposes hereinafter
appearing;
It
is enacted as follows:--
1. Short
title and commencement.---This
Act may be cited as the Punjab Social Services Board (Amendment) Act, 2013.
(2) It
is shall come into force at once.
